question: Write a detailed response explaining the significance of Let us read in the chapter, using the source evidence and supporting details.
answer: One day a funny kind of man Came walking down this street He wore a shoe upon his head And hats upon his feet. He raised the shoe and smiled at me, His manners were polite; But never had I seen before Such a funny sounding sight. He said, “Allow me to present Your Highness with a rose.” And taking out a currant bun He held it to my nose.
